title: The image of a quasi-compact space under a continuous map is quasi-compact
statement: Let $g:T\to Y$ be a continuous map of topological spaces with $T$ quasi-compact (every open covering has a finite subcovering). Then the image $g(T)\subseteq Y$ is quasi-compact in the topology induced from $Y$: every covering of $g(T)$ by subsets open in $g(T)$ has a finite subcovering.
